options.name: all
options.description: Remove all installed quadlets when I(state=absent) (maps to C(podman quadlet rm --all)).

options.name: cmd_args
options.description: Extra global arguments to pass to the C(podman) command (e.g., C(--log-level=debug)). These are placed after the executable and before the subcommand.

options.name: debug
options.description: Return additional information which can be helpful for investigations.

options.name: executable
options.description: Path to C(podman) executable if it is not in the C($PATH) on the machine running C(podman)

options.name: files
options.description: Additional non-quadlet files or URLs to install along with the primary I(src) (quadlet application use-case). Passed positionally to C(podman quadlet install) after I(src). For local files, full idempotency is provided. If any file is a URL, the entire install always reports C(changed=true) since remote content cannot be verified.

options.name: force
options.description: Force removal when I(state=absent) (maps to C(podman quadlet rm --force)).

options.name: name
options.description: Name (filename without path) of an installed quadlet to remove when I(state=absent). If the name does not include the type suffix (e.g. C(.container)), the module will attempt to find a matching quadlet file.

options.name: quadlet_dir
options.description: Override the target quadlet directory used for idempotency checks. By default it follows Podman defaults. C(/etc/containers/systemd/) for root, C(~/.config/containers/systemd/) for non-root. Note this is used for content comparison only and is not passed to Podman.

options.name: reload_systemd
options.description: Control systemd reload behavior in Podman. When true, pass C(--reload-systemd). When false, pass C(--reload-systemd=false).

options.name: src
options.description: Path to a quadlet file, a directory containing a quadlet application, or a URL to install when I(state=present). For local files and directories, full idempotency is provided (content comparison). For remote URLs, the module always installs fresh and reports C(changed=true) since content cannot be verified. Directory installs support only top-level files; nested subdirectories will cause an error.
